dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: There haven't been any new products lately...

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Ah, or could it be... that they've all gone and opened new shops someplace else?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I somewhat doubt that.

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: You have a point. Surely there isn't a single spot in all Natlan livelier than the Chuwen Fair?

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Oh... The People of the Springs doesn't count. The people and Saurians back where I'm from are all busy bathing in the hot springs. Aside from Mualani, you could count those who take their business seriously on a hand or two.

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: And even Mualani spends all day away from the store anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Hehe, come to think of it, someone like me would already be considered a hard worker back in my hometown.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Oh, going so soon? Not even up for a little wander?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hard worker? You look like you're hardly working.

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: If making the most of your breaks helps restore your energy so you can work better, then surely resting should be considered part of your job, too?

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Agh, I shouldn't joke about it. As someone who does night shifts, I'm one to talk...

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: I'll be at the Weary Inn receiving guests in the evening, so if you need somewhere to stay, feel free to come hang out!

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Uhh, I mean, feel free to come support my work!

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Weary Inn!

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: As the name suggests, people feel tired as soon as they arrive here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Err, not that the place itself makes you tired, I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: More like, when people find themselves in an extremely comfortable environment, they're more likely to suddenly feel all the accumulated fatigue.

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: So come, come, sit back and relax! If you need anything, just call me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then don't mind me if I take a break here.

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Please, go ahead — just don't lie down in the middle of the road!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I got hungry the moment I stopped...

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Hehe. That's quite common, I assure you.

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: That's why you need to pause and check on yourself from time to time.

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Come on, have a little grub and rest a bit. Only then can you give yourself the best start for the next leg of your journey.
